title: Paloma Business Onboarding Standard: Application, KYB Review and First Billing Period
content:
This standard governs an application for a Paloma Business account, the KYB documents the business uploads, the KYB review, and what approval sets on the account.

### 1. Who may apply

1.1 An application is accepted only from an owner whose customer profile is a US resident aged at least 18, for a business registered in the United States.

1.2 The business must have been operating at least the plan's months in business, counted from the business formation date on its formation document to the application date. The test is made before the application is accepted, from the formation date the business gives and the account record.

### 2. KYB documents

2.1 Every document in the plan's list of required KYB documents must be received.

2.2 A KYB document is logged only while the account is pending KYB or active, as the account status in the system records shows.

2.3 Each upload reference is logged once: an upload reference already logged as a received KYB document is not logged again.

### 3. Review and approval

3.1 KYB review completes within the plan's KYB review days, counted in Paloma business days from the last required document.

3.2 Approval starts the first billing period on the approval date, which fixes the billing day. When a later month has no such day, the period starts on that month's last day.

3.3 A plan whose minimum commitment is above 0 months sets the commitment end date to the approval date plus that many calendar months.

### 4. Lapse

4.1 An application with documents still missing 30 calendar days after the application date is rejected and closed.

### Worked dates (hypothetical)

| Situation | Result under this standard |
|---|---|
| Plan requires 3 months in business; formed 15 January, application dated 15 April | 3 months counted to the application date: the requirement is met |
| Same plan; formed 15 January, application dated 10 April | Fewer than 3 months: the requirement is not met |
| Approved on the 31st of a month | The billing day is the 31st; in a month of 30 days the period starts on the 30th, and in February on its last day |
| Approved 10 March on a plan with a 12-month minimum commitment | Commitment end date 10 March of the following year |
| Approved on a plan with a minimum commitment of 0 months | No commitment end date is set |
| Application dated 1 June, a required document still missing on 1 July | 30 calendar days have passed with documents missing: the application is rejected and closed |
| Account status suspended, owner uploads a KYB document | Not logged: documents are logged only while pending KYB or active |
